name: pdf-toolkit
display_name: PDF Tools - View, Fill, Merge, Split, Manage Pages, Extract
description: A full local PDF workflow for Claude Desktop and other local MCP hosts: interactive viewing, form filling with reusable profiles, page organization, extraction, and analysis.
long_description:
PDF Tools turns Claude Desktop into a complete local PDF workstation. Instead of just opening a PDF, you can inspect it visually, fill forms, save reusable profiles, reorganize pages, extract structured data, and analyze document content without uploading files anywhere.

This package targets Claude Desktop and other local MCP hosts today. It does not yet include a remote Claude/Cowork connector.

**Interactive PDF Viewer:**
• View PDFs with page navigation, zoom, search, text selection, and fullscreen
• See form fields in a sidebar with fill status
• Use visual page management to reorder, rotate, and remove pages before saving a new copy

**Forms & Reusable Profiles:**
• Fill W-9s, 1099s, rental applications, waivers, and any fillable PDF
• Save personal or business details as reusable profiles
• List, load, and apply saved profiles so repeated forms take seconds instead of minutes
• Bulk fill many PDFs from CSV data and validate required fields before submission

**Page Organization Tools:**
• Merge multiple PDFs into one document
• Split PDFs by exact page ranges or regular intervals
• Rotate and reorder pages, or apply a full page plan in one pass
• Keep the original intact by saving organized output as a new file

**Extraction & Analysis:**
• Read document text for summarization, question answering, and research workflows
• Read specific page ranges and search PDF text with page-numbered snippets
• Extract structured data to CSV
• Inspect page-level details like orientation, text presence, images, and likely blank pages
• Review metadata such as page count, dimensions, form fields, and file size

**Works with many PDF types:** Forms, contracts, research papers, technical manuals, invoices, financial statements, scanned documents, and encrypted PDFs.

**Best for:** People who need more than a viewer — researchers reviewing papers, operators processing forms, lawyers organizing contracts, accountants handling tax documents, and anyone who wants local PDF workflows without sending files to a web app.

tools.name: display_pdf
tools.description: Display an interactive PDF viewer with search, navigation, zoom, and form field detection

tools.name: list_pdfs
tools.description: List all PDF files in a directory

tools.name: read_pdf_fields
tools.description: Read all form fields from a PDF file

tools.name: fill_pdf
tools.description: Fill a PDF form with provided data and save it

tools.name: bulk_fill_from_csv
tools.description: Fill multiple PDFs using data from a CSV file

tools.name: save_profile
tools.description: Save form data as a reusable profile

tools.name: load_profile
tools.description: Load a saved profile

tools.name: list_profiles
tools.description: List all saved profiles

tools.name: fill_with_profile
tools.description: Fill a PDF using a saved profile

tools.name: extract_to_csv
tools.description: Extract form data from filled PDFs to a CSV file

tools.name: validate_pdf
tools.description: Validate if all required fields in a PDF are filled

tools.name: read_pdf_content
tools.description: Read and analyze the full content of a PDF file - extract text, summarize, convert to other formats, or answer questions about the document

tools.name: read_pdf_pages
tools.description: Read a bounded page range from a PDF with page-numbered structured output

tools.name: render_pdf_page
tools.description: Render one PDF page to PNG for visual reasoning on scanned or image-heavy documents

tools.name: render_pdf_region
tools.description: Render a bounded PDF region to PNG using top-left point coordinates

tools.name: search_pdf_text
tools.description: Search extracted PDF text for a phrase and return page-numbered snippets

tools.name: get_pdf_resource_uri
tools.description: Get a resource URI for a PDF file that can be used with Claude's built-in PDF reading capabilities via the Resources API

tools.name: read_pdf_bytes
tools.description: Read PDF file bytes in chunks (for UI rendering)

tools.name: merge_pdfs
tools.description: Merge multiple PDF files into a single PDF

tools.name: split_pdf
tools.description: Split a PDF into multiple files by page ranges or intervals

tools.name: rotate_pdf_pages
tools.description: Rotate pages in a PDF by 90, 180, or 270 degrees

tools.name: reorder_pdf_pages
tools.description: Rearrange the pages of a PDF in a new order

tools.name: get_pdf_info
tools.description: Get metadata about a PDF: page count, file size, dimensions, form fields

tools.name: apply_page_plan
tools.description: Reorder, rotate, and delete PDF pages in one pass — saves as a new file

tools.name: get_page_analysis
tools.description: Analyze PDF pages for blank detection, orientation, text content, and image presence

tools.name: fetch_pdf_from_url
tools.description: Download a PDF from an HTTP(S) URL to the user's local machine — works when Claude's WebFetch is blocked

tools.name: create_signature
tools.description: Save a reusable typed-name or image signature to ~/.pdf-toolkit-files/signatures/

tools.name: list_signatures
tools.description: List all saved signatures

tools.name: load_signature
tools.description: Load one saved signature by name, including preview data for image signatures

tools.name: get_active_document
tools.description: Return the toolkit's current canonical PDF path, backup path, and last mutation metadata

tools.name: set_active_document
tools.description: Rehydrate the toolkit's active document state from the currently open viewer session

tools.name: add_signature_field
tools.description: Draw a visible 'Sign here' placeholder box on a PDF page (marks location — does NOT sign)

tools.name: apply_signature
tools.description: Stamp a saved signature at a specific location — requires explicit human intent (user_intent_statement + user_confirmed_at). Basic local stamp, not cryptographic signing.

tools.name: prepare_signing_packet
tools.description: Fill form fields AND add sign-here placeholder boxes in one pass — returns a pending-signatures manifest

tools.name: detect_signature_zones
tools.description: Find every place in a PDF where a signature, initials, or date should go — typed zone list with coordinates. Use BEFORE apply_signature; never guess coordinates.

tools.name: apply_text
tools.description: Stamp a plain text string at a location (for date zones or arbitrary text fills — no intent required)

tools.name: reveal_in_finder
tools.description: Open the OS file manager with the given file selected — used by the viewer to surface the active PDF or its backup

prompts.name: view_and_analyze_pdf
prompts.description: Open and analyze any PDF document
prompts.text: I'll open your PDF in the interactive viewer and analyze it, focusing on ${arguments.focus}. I can extract key findings, summarize sections, answer questions about specific pages, pull out structured data, and identify form fields if present.

prompts.name: research_paper_analysis
prompts.text: I'll open your research paper in the interactive viewer and analyze it, focusing on ${arguments.focus_area}. I can extract key findings and methodology, identify research gaps, create chapter-by-chapter summaries, pull out all citations, and generate a literature review outline.

prompts.name: contract_comparison
prompts.text: I'll compare multiple contracts or legal documents, focusing on ${arguments.comparison_focus}. I'll highlight changed clauses, modified terms, added/removed sections, pricing differences, liability changes, and create a comparison summary.

prompts.name: financial_report_extraction
prompts.text: I'll extract and analyze data from your financial PDFs including all tables and key metrics. I'll convert the data to ${arguments.output_format} format for analysis, with specific page references for all extracted information.

prompts.name: document_qa_session
prompts.text: Let's discuss your PDF document. Starting with: ${arguments.initial_question}. I can find specific information, explain complex sections, cross-reference different parts, extract quotes with page numbers, and answer 'what if' scenarios.

prompts.name: bulk_invoice_processing
prompts.description: Process multiple invoices into structured data
prompts.text: I'll process all invoice PDFs in ${arguments.folder_path} and create a unified dataset in ${arguments.output_format} format. I'll extract vendor names, invoice numbers, dates, line items, totals, tax amounts, and payment terms.

prompts.name: technical_documentation_summary
prompts.text: I'll analyze your technical documentation and create ${arguments.summary_type}. I'll extract code examples, create reference guides, identify implementation steps, and summarize troubleshooting sections.

prompts.name: fill_w9_business
prompts.text: I'll open your W-9 in the interactive viewer so you can see it, then fill it for your business. I need: Business legal name, DBA/trade name (if different), business type (LLC/Corp/Partnership), tax classification, EIN, and business address. I'll properly check the correct tax classification boxes and ensure the form meets IRS requirements.

prompts.name: batch_invoices
prompts.text: I'll help you batch process invoices. Point me to the folder containing your invoice PDFs. I can: extract all amounts and dates, create a summary spreadsheet, identify missing information, calculate totals by vendor/date/category. What specific data do you need extracted?

prompts.name: rental_application
prompts.text: I'll open your rental application in the viewer and help complete it. Have ready: personal info, employment history (3 years), income verification, previous addresses (3 years), references, vehicle info, and emergency contact. I'll ensure all required fields are filled and flag any that need supporting documents.

prompts.name: extract_1099_data
prompts.text: I'll extract all data from your 1099 forms (1099-NEC, 1099-MISC, 1099-DIV, 1099-INT, etc.) and create a tax summary. I'll organize by payer, identify the type of income, sum totals by category, and format it for easy import into tax software.

prompts.name: merge_documents
prompts.description: Combine multiple PDFs into one document
prompts.text: I'll merge your PDF files into a single document. Just tell me which files to combine and where to save the result. I'll preserve the page order and show you the merged result in the viewer so you can verify it looks right. All processing happens locally on your computer — nothing is uploaded.

prompts.name: split_large_document
prompts.description: Split a PDF into smaller files
prompts.text: I'll split your PDF into separate files. You can specify exact page ranges (e.g., pages 1-10, 11-20) or split at regular intervals (e.g., every 5 pages). I'll save each section as its own PDF file. Great for breaking up large reports, separating chapters, or extracting specific sections.

prompts.name: organize_scanned_pages
prompts.description: Rotate and reorder scanned PDF pages
prompts.text: I'll help fix up your scanned PDF. I can rotate sideways or upside-down pages (90°, 180°, or 270°), and reorder pages that were scanned out of sequence. I'll show you the result in the viewer so you can confirm everything looks right before saving.

download_directory.title: Download Directory
download_directory.description: Where PDFs saved via fetch_pdf_from_url land by default. You can still override per-call with the destination_dir argument, but this is the default for new downloads.

default_pdf_directory.title: Default PDFs Folder
default_pdf_directory.description: Where list_pdfs looks when no directory is specified.

allowed_directories.title: Allowed PDF Directories
allowed_directories.description: Folders this extension may read from or write to. PDF tools will refuse paths outside these folders. Profiles and saved signatures remain in the extension's private local store.
